**Description**
Every token a large language model generates depends on data reaching the right accelerator at the right moment. As AI models outgrow any single chip, the network between accelerators becomes the bottleneck that decides how fast — and how affordably — the world's largest models can serve real users. That network layer is what our team builds.
  
  
We're looking for an engineer to work at the frontier of disaggregated inference: splitting LLM serving into separate prefill and decode pools and moving the model's KV cache between them at the limit of what the hardware allows. Get it right and users get answers in milliseconds; get it wrong and the fastest accelerators in the world sit idle waiting on data. You'll build components of the high-speed transfer path that make that difference, and you'll learn to measure success in how close we run to the theoretical peak of the machine.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**
Build and optimize the low-level data-movement software that transfers KV cache and activations across accelerators, servers, and heterogeneous memory — over AWS's highest-performance network fabric.
  
  
Profile real workloads, find the true bottleneck, and close the gap between "it works" and "it runs fast" — pushing components toward the hardware's limit.
  
  
Work across the stack — from network transport up to the inference frameworks — learning from the teams building the chips, runtime, and models.
  
  
Deliver features that ship to our largest clusters, for our largest customers, serving the largest AI models in production.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
Strong C/C++ and a genuine interest in low-level, performance-critical systems — solid command of Linux, memory, and writing fast code.
  
  
The instinct to ask "how fast could this go?" and the discipline to measure it.
  
  
Exposure to high-speed networking, HPC interconnects, or GPU/accelerator systems (RDMA, InfiniBand, libfabric, UCX, NCCL, MPI) is a strong plus; embedded-systems experience is welcome.
  
  
Prior AI/ML experience is not required — if you're a strong systems engineer eager to learn, we'll teach you the ML side.
  
  
If you like solving genuinely hard problems, working alongside HPC and ML customers, iterating fast, and shipping at a scale few places can offer, come join us. You'll work alongside senior engineers and Principal Engineers who've built this layer from the ground up, with real room to grow your scope and technical depth — on a team at the leading edge of AI/ML infrastructure.
  
  
About the team: You'd be joining Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS. Annapurna designs the hardware and software building blocks behind EC2 — every EC2 instance runs on hardware we designed. We specialize in the chips, systems, and software that optimize the AWS customer experience, and this team sits where AI meets the silicon and the network underneath it.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Annapurna Labs, a crucial part of AWS, is responsible for developing hardware and software components for EC2 infrastructure. Our team focuses on building networking solutions that for Machine Learning (ML) and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads on AWS.
  
  
We have mixed discipline orgs, you’d be working side by side with infrastructure experts, hardware engineers, RTL engineers, scientists & architects. **Description**
Join the team that is part of a foundational service for distributed storage used across AWS. Our systems serve as critical building blocks for services like S3, DynamoDB, EC2 Networking, and more.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to solve complex distributed systems challenges that impact services across AWS. We are looking for engineers who thrive on technical challenges and passionate about building highly available, durable systems with minimal dependencies. And collaborate with talented peers to design and implement robust solutions, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure operational excellence. If you are excited about distributed systems engineering, with the opportunity to build and operate systems with impact across AWS services, this role is for you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You work with the team to design, build, and operate systems that are secure, available, and performant.
* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic navigating constraints.
* You create maintainable software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You focus on operational excellence, understanding how decisions impact operational costs, and take on projects that make software easier to maintain.

A day in the life
  
  
We are a team that enjoys solving hard problems across the entire software stack, from application logic down to the kernel and networking stack. Engineering rigor and excellence are central to everything we deliver. We constantly share knowledge and grow together through technical deep-dives and demos. We love a good debate, evaluating multiple perspectives and approaches to arrive at thoughtful decisions on critical questions.
  
  
Operational excellence isn't just a goal - it's a critical requirement in our work. We strive for continuous improvement, believing that this pursuit strengthens both our systems and our engineering skills.
  
  

* Designing and driving technical decisions that balance competing priorities and constraints
* Implementing changes at a high quality achieving stringent requirements for availability, security, and performance
* Creating and implementing automation that improve system reliability and operational efficiency
* Working closely with dependent teams to enhance system capabilities and resolve technical challenges
* Driving investigations to root cause anomalies, and delivering robust solutions

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Who We Are
  
  
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
  
  
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
  
  
**About The Role**
Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do
**substantive knowledge work from their phone**
.
  
  
A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.
  
  
As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.
  
  
This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.
  
  
What You'll Achieve
  
  

* Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.
* Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.
* By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.
* Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

Skills You'll Need to Bring
  
  

* Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.
* Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.
* Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.
* Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.
* AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.

**Job Overview And Responsibilities**
The Analyst – Fraud Data provides fraud business intelligence, analysis and storytelling that explains how fraud affects customers, operations, revenue and enterprise risk. This role integrates operational data on fraud detected, prevented and realized to quantify exposure, control outcomes, customer friction and financial impact. The Analyst uses approved artificial intelligence and automation tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns, summarize findings, develop reporting content and improve the productivity and consistency of recurring workflows, with appropriate human validation and data-governance controls. The individual in this position develops clear narratives, dashboards and executive insights that connect fraud trends to business priorities and support informed decisions across the enterprise.
  
  
**Fraud Business Impact Intelligence**

* Integrate fraud detected, prevented and realized-loss data to explain the scale, drivers and business implications of fraud across products, channels and customer journeys

**Executive Storytelling & Insights**

* Translate complex operational and analytical findings into clear narratives, presentations and recommendations tailored to senior leaders and business stakeholders; use approved AI tools to accelerate synthesis, drafting and audience-specific communication with human review

**Operational Performance Reporting**

* Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards covering fraud volumes, prevented loss, realized loss, recovery, customer friction, operational workload and control outcomes; automate recurring data preparation, quality checks and reporting workflows where appropriate

**Trend & Root-Cause Analysis**

* Analyze shifts in fraud activity and operational results to identify material trends, root causes, emerging risks and changes in business exposure; use approved AI-assisted methods to accelerate exploration, pattern identification and summarization

**Financial & Customer Impact Measurement**

* Quantify the revenue, loss, cost, customer and operational effects of fraud and fraud controls, including tradeoffs between risk reduction and customer experience

**Data Quality, Reporting Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish consistent definitions, validation checks, documentation and reconciliation practices for fraud performance metrics, reporting datasets and AI-assisted outputs; protect sensitive data and validate accuracy, bias and business context

**Cross-Functional Business Partnership**

* Partner with Fraud Strategy, Operations, Loyalty,
* Digital Technology, Customer Insights, Sales and other teams to align metrics, interpret results and turn insights into action

**Qualifications**
What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):
  
  

* Bachelor's degree. with preference for Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems or a related quantitative or business field; equivalent experience accepted
* 2+ years of relevant experience in fraud analytics, business intelligence, operational analytics, financial analysis, risk analytics, ECDLP or a related discipline
* Demonstrated ability to quantify business impact, create clear data visualizations and translate analytical findings into concise recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to use approved generative AI and automation tools to improve analytical, reporting and documentation productivity while validating outputs
* SQL proficiency and experience reconciling, analyzing and interpreting large operational datasets
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
* Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
* Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):
  
  

* Master's degree
* Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics or a related discipline
* Developing executive-ready reporting, presentations and narratives for senior business stakeholders
* Experience with fraud, retail, e-commerce, airline, financial services or another high-volume customer environment
* Knowledge of fraud operations, loss prevention, customer experience metrics, financial measurement or operational performance management; experience with enterprise AI assistants, natural-language analytics or workflow automation
* Tableau, Power BI, Looker or comparable visualization and reporting platform experience

**Description**
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?
  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of impacting variables and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Core Networking team is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) team. As a Software Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying and scaling the services that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global datacenters.
  
  
AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Owning multiple services and features, architecting them to scale with robust unit tests and metrics
* Understanding customer needs by working with external and internal stakeholders and translating it to software requirements and execution plans
* Delivering quality features on-time and on-budget and executing against project plans and delivery commitments.
* Manage your day-to-day development activities, participate in designs, design review, code review, and implementation.
* Mentoring and guiding junior engineers towards good software development techniques
* Maintaining current technical knowledge to support rapidly changing technology, always on a look out for new technologies and work with the team in bringing in new technologies.

A day in the life
  
  
You will architect, design, implement, test, and deploy new features to improve scale and availability of the network
  
  
You will look for continuous improvement to reduce the cost of operating the network
  
  
You will exercise the highest bar for security in both code and operations.

A new open-source model is released and you are compelled to reach inside and understand how it actually works. You instinctively try to push it beyond what most people say is already impressive. You observe model behavior and don’t think, “What’s a better prompt?”, but “How do I improve its fundamentals?”

Our Senior Machine Learning Engineer will operate deep within the model stack, working directly with weights, activations, and architectures to build the systems that make AI governance deterministic. Your work powers the Policy Engine, the core technology that gives enterprises real-time, auditable control over model behavior in production. Your mandate is ostensibly simple but difficult in execution: determine how a model can be improved for a specific purpose and build the systems that operationalize that within our platform.

As opposed to simply
*using*
models, you will probe the mechanics of their cognition.

**What You Will Do**

* Take ideas from mechanistic interpretability and related work and turn them into code that runs in production, making research into reality.
* Work directly with model internals to improve behavior and performance across commercial and open-source models.
* Leverage techniques like activation patching, control vectors, and feature extraction to achieve targeted, repeatable improvements in model output.
* Build the evaluation and deployment loops needed to ship changes reliably into enterprise environments.
* Design and optimize the feature-level intervention systems that enable deterministic policy enforcement at inference time.

**Who You Are**

* Strong understanding of Transformer architectures, PyTorch internals, and the mathematical foundations of deep learning.
* Have trained, fine-tuned, or optimized models beyond superficial augmentation.
* Can read a paper, decide what matters, and implement it.
* Notice when something is not working and take ownership of fixing it.
* Motivated by the challenge of making large language models reliable and controllable enough for the highest-stakes enterprise applications.

**Our Stack**

* **Languages:**
  Python, Rust, and Node/TypeScript, with React on the frontend
* **Data:**
  Postgresql, vector, and graph databases
* **Infra:**
  Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, across several cloud providers and customer VPCs
* **ML:**
  Self hosted models on multiple GPU providers and frontier APIs

AWS Proactive Security protects AWS by finding and fixing security risks before anyone can exploit them. We build the technology that keeps AWS infrastructure, pipelines and accounts in a known secure state, at a scale few organizations ever see.

Drift Defender continuously checks resources against security intents, flags deviations and brings them back into compliance without slowing builders down. The team keeps expanding Drift Defender's coverage and its integrations across the AWS security ecosystem. This work is central to how AWS scales its security posture, and it directly reduces risk for AWS and its customers.

Experience in security, compliance automation or infrastructure-as-code is a strong plus.
  
  
Amazon offers competitive salary, stock grants, health coverage and other benefits.

As a Software Development Engineer on Drift Defender, you will:
  
  

* Design, build and operate large-scale distributed services that detect and fix security drift across AWS.

AIR is seeking a
**Data Scientist**
to join our Education Systems and Policy (ESP) team, providing advanced quantitative and technical expertise across a range of education research and evaluation projects. In this role, you will apply rigorous analytic methods to complex education policy and systems questions while helping develop innovative tools and resources that improve project efficiency, strengthen analytic capabilities, and enhance the value we deliver to clients. You will work closely with researchers, technical staff, and project leaders to bridge education content expertise with data science and technical development, contributing to high-quality analyses, reproducible workflows, and practical solutions that advance ESP’s research and client work.
  
  
Candidates hired for the position may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.
  
  
**About AIR**
Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead or contribute to the design and execution of rigorous quantitative research and evaluation projects across multiple Education Systems and Policy initiatives.
* Apply appropriate quantitative methods to collect, manage, analyze, and interpret data, including leading inferential analyses for both causal and non‑causal research questions.
* Develop, maintain, and document reproducible and collaborative analytic workflows, including data management processes and quality control procedures.
* Review, quality‑check, and strengthen analytic code and outputs produced by junior staff; provide guidance and mentorship to promote best practices in analysis and documentation.
* Translate complex analytic findings into clear, actionable insights for client reports, technical memos, presentations, and briefings.
* Manage discrete project tasks or analytic components, including planning timelines, tracking deliverables, and coordinating with project leadership and clients.
* Support proposal development by contributing to technical and analytic sections and helping shape study design and analytic approaches.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders through meetings and dissemination activities, contributing to a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

**Qualifications**
**Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

* Master's or doctoral degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, computational social science, education data science, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated understanding of education policy, education systems and school and district finance.
* Demonstrated experience supporting or leading quantitative research or evaluation projects, preferably for public-sector, nonprofit, or education-focused clients.
* Experience designing and executing inferential analyses and contributing to research reports, briefs, or presentations.
* Experience managing and maintaining analytic datasets, including documentation, quality control, and reproducible workflows.
* Experience with machine learning methods or interest in applying ML to support causal and non-causal research.
* Experience working in education or K–12 research contexts.

**Skills**

* Proficiency in R, Stata, or Python for applied quantitative analysis.
* Ability to review, quality-check, and improve others’ analytic code and support junior staff through guidance and mentorship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to accuracy and research, best practices.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

**Description**
The Data Scientist designs, develops, and implements advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning solutions that improve business decision-making and operational performance. The Data Scientist partners with business stakeholders, Business Intelligence professionals, and Data Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions. The role develops and maintains data assets, advanced analytical models, AI solutions, and supporting data transformations while establishing technical standards and best practices for analytics and AI development.
  
  
The incumbent in this position is expected to model the following practices on a daily basis:
  
  

* Demonstrate alignment with the company's mission and core business values;
* Collaborate with key internal/external resources;
* Participate in ongoing self-development.

**Essential Functions**

* Models, promotes, reinforces, and rewards the consistent use of HOLT’s Values Based Leadership (VBL) tools, models, and processes to ensure alignment with our Vision, Values, and Mission
* Collaborates with leadership and business units to identify high-value opportunities for advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and governed semantic solutions
* Designs, develops, evaluates, deploys, and monitors statistical, predictive, prescriptive, machine learning, and artificial intelligence solutions that address business opportunities and operational challenges
* Develops AI solutions using structured and unstructured enterprise data and evaluates emerging AI technologies for responsible integration into business processes and analytical products
* Establishes standards and best practices for AI development, evaluation, documentation, deployment, monitoring, explainability, and responsible use
* Designs, develops, deploys, and maintains enterprise semantic models within Microsoft Fabric
* Transforms governed Gold-layer data into analytics-ready semantic models by defining dimensional structures, relationships, measures, calculations, hierarchies, metadata, and business context
* Partners with Data Engineering teams to define and validate Gold-layer requirements necessary to support semantic models and downstream analytical solutions
* Ensures semantic models provide consistent business definitions, calculations, and context across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, AI solutions, and other downstream consumers
* Optimizes semantic models for performance, scalability, usability, security, and maintainability
* Implements modern development lifecycle practices for semantic models and analytical solutions, including Git-based source control, versioning, testing, peer review, CI/CD, and deployment across development, test, and production environments
* Partners with Business Intelligence professionals to ensure semantic models and analytical solutions effectively support enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, AI applications, and business decision-making
* Extracts, analyzes, identifies, and assesses qualitative and quantitative patterns, trends, anomalies, and relationships from large and complex data sets
* Prepares technical documentation and communicates analytical findings, model behavior, data requirements, and solution design to technical and business audiences
* Provides training and support and serves as a technical expert for semantic modeling, advanced analytics, and AI throughout the organization
* Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending events, webinars, and educational opportunities
* Works safely at all times and adheres to all applicable safety policies; complies with all company policies, procedures, and standards
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Advanced knowledge of data science, statistical analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytical methods
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric architecture and development, including semantic models, notebooks, and related analytical capabilities
* Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python for data transformation, analysis, modeling, and solution development
* Strong knowledge of Power BI semantic models and DAX, including model performance optimization and reusable measure design
* Working knowledge of generative AI, large language model concepts, conversational analytics, and enterprise AI solution patterns
* Experience with Git-based source control, Azure DevOps, pull requests, CI/CD, testing, and deployment practices
* Knowledge of data governance, lineage, metadata management, documentation, data quality, and analytical security concepts including row-level and object-level security
* Ability to identify complex problems, evaluate alternatives, and design scalable analytical and technical solutions
* Excellent verbal, written, communication, presentation, interpersonal, and customer service skills. With the ability to communicate complex technical and analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, IT, leadership, and business teams
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining technical quality and documentation standards
* Ability to train, mentor, and establish technical best practices for others

**Education and Experience:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, business intelligence, data modeling, or related disciplines required
* Bachelor's Degree required; BA/BS in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline preferred
* Master's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline preferred
* Demonstrated experience developing statistical, machine learning, or artificial intelligence solutions required

**About GameChanger:**
We believe in the life-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.
  
  
So if you love sports and their community-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.
  
  
**The Position:**
We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Ads team, which builds the systems that power display and video advertising across GameChanger’s Android, iOS, and web apps, including live game streams.
  
  
This is a backend-first role with opportunities to deliver features through to our Android app. Most of your work will focus on building services and APIs in Node.js and TypeScript as we move more advertising logic from our apps to the server. You’ll help build server-driven ad experiences and expand our integrations with advertising partners, contributing to systems that support our growing advertising business.
  
  
You’ll bring strong backend experience and hands-on experience shipping Android features. As priorities shift, you’ll contribute to our Android codebase with support from a senior Android engineer. You’ll partner with staff and senior engineers, product, and our media sales team, with room to deepen your expertise and take on greater ownership over time. You will report to the Engineering Manager on our Ads team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Design, build, and operate backend services in Node.js and TypeScript that power ad targeting, eligibility, and delivery across our apps.
* Develop server-driven APIs and configuration that move advertising logic out of our apps and allow us to update ad experiences without waiting for an app release.
* Build and maintain integrations with ad-serving and programmatic advertising partners, including Google Ad Manager, and contribute to new header bidding capabilities.
* Implement and ship Android features in Kotlin, connecting backend services to advertising experiences in our app.
* Partner with staff and senior engineers to turn technical designs into reliable, maintainable services and features.
* Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of our advertising systems through testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

**Who You Are:**

* You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in building and operating backend services in production.
* You have strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript, including API design and working with relational or NoSQL databases.
* You have hands-on experience shipping features in a production Android app using Kotlin and can explain your implementation decisions.
* You can take a defined technical problem from design through implementation, testing, and release, working independently and seeking input when needed.
* You enjoy working across backend and mobile, collaborating with teammates, and learning new parts of a system as priorities evolve.
* Bonus: You have experience with advertising technology—such as Google Ad Manager, IMA, VAST, header bidding, or Prebid—and/or live video streaming.

**Perks:**

* Work remotely throughout the US\* or from our well-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY.
* Unlimited vacation policy.
* Paid volunteer opportunities.
* Technology stipend - $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology.
* WFH stipend - $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable.
* Monthly physical, mental, wellness & learning stipend offered through Holisticly.
* Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe.
* Full health benefits - medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents.
* Retirement savings - Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match.
* Life insurance - basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life.
* Disability leave - short-term disability and long-term disability.
* Company paid parental leave - up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.
* Family building benefits offered through Progyny.
* DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount.

**Role Summary**
This mid-to-senior Software Developer role supports a data protection engineering organization within a regulated financial services environment. The position joins a small, agile squad responsible for building and scaling Python APIs and microservices that support scanning automation, data masking, policy controls, scheduling, authentication, and other cybersecurity controls. The role focuses on Python, FastAPI, Beanie, MongoDB, cloud environments, DevOps, and the secure, governed use of AI throughout the software development lifecycle. Participation in an on-call rotation and enterprise application support is required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build, onboard, and maintain Python API microservices using FastAPI, Beanie, and MongoDB to detect sensitive data across structured and unstructured sources.
* Develop just-in-time access and scan orchestration capabilities that support data security, compliance, privacy, and threat monitoring.
* Create automation scripts and observability solutions that reduce manual effort and improve engineering efficiency.
* Support CI/CD and DevOps activities using Git, Jenkins, test automation, and production service delivery practices.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and troubleshoot application, operating system, and network issues across Linux and Windows environments.
* Apply AI-assisted and agentic development practices to improve automation and analyze scan results and dashboard data with appropriate human oversight.
* Follow secure and governed AI software development lifecycle practices across requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration with stakeholder groups.
* Work within agile team practices, track deliverables in Jira, and release small, incremental improvements.
* Support change and incident management under ITIL practices while documenting and sharing technical knowledge across global data protection teams.

**Qualifications**

* Five or more years of professional Python development experience building and scaling APIs and microservices, ideally in financial services or another regulated environment.
* Hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, Beanie, and MongoDB as a primary database.
* Experience with Git, Jenkins, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* In-depth Linux experience and working knowledge of Windows.
* Knowledge of critical cybersecurity controls, data protection concepts, and network troubleshooting and debugging.
* Working knowledge of the AI software development lifecycle, including secure and governed AI use with human oversight.
* Experience working in agile development teams and using Jira for work tracking.
* Proven technical and application support experience with enterprise systems, including knowledge of ITIL practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, a collaborative approach, and an automation mindset.
* Preferred experience with ReactJS or AngularJS, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Flux, Grafana, Loki, BigID, Varonis, Snyk, data analytics, DLP, or data security posture management concepts.

Able to decide when to use traditional code versus large language models or AI agents. Designs for probabilistic AI behavior, fallback approaches, human review, and cost, latency, and reliability trade-offs.

**Brief Job Description**
The Data Analyst V position oversees and performs highly advanced data verification by collecting, querying, and analyzing data using standard statistical tools, applications, methods, and techniques. Serving as an escalation point, Data Analyst V reviews complex variances or findings requiring additional analysis. The Data Analyst V ensures consistency and accuracy across all team reporting and communicates findings and recommendations to the QRU manager. Data Analyst V supports daily operational coordination by communicating workload priorities, data review requirements, and results to team members and by providing technical guidance and on-the-job support to other Data Analysts as directed by the QRU manager. Additional duties include supporting special projects, process improvements, and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions (EJFs)**

* Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.
* Oversees and performs highly advanced data verification (collecting, querying, and analyzing data using standard statistical tools, applications, methods, and techniques) and serves as an escalation point for complex variances or findings that require additional review. (60%)
* Ensures consistency and accuracy across all team reporting and communicates findings and recommendations to the QRU manager and other members of leadership on behalf of the team. (20%)
* Supports day-to-day operational coordination; communicates workload priorities, data review requirements, and results to team members and/or provides technical guidance and on-the-job support to other Data Analysts, under the discretion of the QRU manager. (15%)
* Other duties as assigned to support the mission and operations of the Provider Finance Department and Texas Health and Human Services, including assisting with special projects, process improvements, cross-functional collaboration, and adapting to evolving organizational needs. (5%)

**Knowledge Of**
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs):**

* Knowledge of data analysis techniques and best practices.
* Knowledge of PFD and other areas within HHS.
* Knowledge of data quality and integrity processes.
* Knowledge of the principles, practices, and techniques of database and application design, development, and structure.
* Knowledge of and experience with reporting and visualization tools.

**Skill In**

* Skill in communicating to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Skill in complex analytic work, identifying trends, concerns, recommending opportunities for improvement as well as areas of excellence.
* Skill in using SQL, SAS, SPSS, Python, and other query languages.
* Skill in using Extract, Transform, and Load tools.

**Ability To**

* Ability to utilize keen attention to detail and the ability to implement creative solutions to problems.
* Ability to work collaboratively across PFD to accomplish objectives.
* Able to balance team and individual responsibilities.
* Ability to work on a team and to be flexible and creative with data demands.
* Ability to plan, organize, and conduct data analytic projects.
* Ability to develop and interpret data charts, maps, and tables.
* Ability to interpret and publish data analytic findings.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment and show initiative.
* Ability to maintain detailed and organized documentation of data analytic projects.
* Ability to compile, review, and analyze data; to prepare reports; to maintain accuracy and attention to detail; to communicate effectively; and to supervise the work of others.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you sit cross-functionally across the Sales, Product, R&D, and Implementation teams. **🛠️ About Our Simulation Teams**
Simulation is a mission-critical part of how we build Wayve's driving intelligence. It lets teams evaluate changes faster, investigate failures and build confidence in the driving stack before it reaches the road.
  
  
Wayve's end-to-end driving stack creates a distinctive simulation challenge. There are no intermediate stages where simulated signals can be injected, so simulation has to be end to end too: reproducing the behaviour of a learned driving system across sensor data, model inference, routing, control and vehicle dynamics. Our simulator needs to be realistic enough to give meaningful signal, reproducible enough for teams to trust the results, and descriptive enough to explain the differences between simulated and on-road behaviour.
  
  
You'll join the Core Simulation team. Our open-loop and closed-loop workflows share one codebase, with different components configured depending on the use case. You'll start with the team focused on high-scale open-loop evaluation, while contributing to shared components that also underpin GAIA-powered closed-loop simulation, where generative world models are integrated with the driving stack. Your role is to enable and productionise these capabilities, not primarily to train the models.
  
  
**🧠 Your day-to-day**

* Work hands-on in our shared, modern C++ and Python simulation codebase
* Implement scoped features and integrate driving-stack components, simulated robot systems and new vehicle-platform capabilities
* Support and test different simulation configurations, with an initial focus on high-scale open-loop evaluation
* Investigate differences between on-road and simulated execution, tracing issues across component interfaces, data flows, timing and configuration
* Improve automated testing, observability, reproducibility, reliability and developer tooling
* Profile simulator workloads and contribute performance and scalability improvements

* Integrating driving-stack components, simulated robot systems and new vehicle platforms into the shared simulation environment
